# Findings: track import paths, naming, network services, geocoding, coords, persistence

## 1. Every "import a track" code path

**A. GPX file picked from the phone (the only file-based import)**

- UI entry: `lib/ui/ride/gpx_library_page.dart:117` (AppBar icon, `_importFile`).
- Chain: `openFile()` → `file.readAsBytes()` → `name = file.name` (`:54`) → `GpxUtil.looksLikeGpx(bytes)` → `GpxLibraryStore.putBytes(name, bytes)` (`:61`).
- Name decision: `lib/ride/gpx_library_store.dart:58-82`. File stored under `GpxUtil.safeFileName(fileName)`, then:
  - `lib/ride/gpx_library_store.dart:65` `final sum = GpxUtil.parse(xml);`
  - `lib/ride/gpx_library_store.dart:76` `displayName: sum.name.isEmpty ? null : sum.name,`
  - So the display name = first `<name>` inside the GPX; falls back to the file stem via `RideRecord.title` (`lib/ride/ride_record_store.dart:46-53`).
- This page has no rename UI — only delete (`:86`) and upload-to-device (`:73`). List title is `rec.title` (`:148`).

**B. Tracks pulled from the BLE device (`mtp/record/*.gpx`)**

- UI entry: `lib/ui/device/device_page.dart:39` `_sync()` → button in Device tab; task kind `'mcu_sync'` (`:30`), `TransferCenter.begin(...)` `:63`.
- Chain: `McuSync.pullRideRecords(client, onProgress:)` (`lib/ui/device/device_page.dart:69`).
  - `lib/ride/mcu_sync.dart:61` `list = await client.fsList(McuFsPaths.recordDir)` with `recordDir = 'mtp/record'` (`:32`).
  - skips entries already local with same `remoteSize` (`:71-75`), downloads bytes (`:91`), then `await store.putFile(fileName: e.name, bytes: bytes, remoteSize: e.size)` (`:105-109`). **No name is passed** — name is derived from the GPX content.
- Name decision inside `RideRecordStore.putFile` (`lib/ride/ride_record_store.dart:201-245`):
  - `:213-219` preserve-on-resync rule: `final keepName = prev != null && prev.userRenamed && (prev.displayName?.trim().isNotEmpty ?? false); if (keepName) xml = GpxUtil.setName(xml, prev!.displayName!.trim());`
  - `:234-236` `displayName: keepName ? prev!.displayName!.trim() : (sum.name.isEmpty ? null : sum.name)`
  - `:238` `userRenamed: keepName`
- After sync the shell refreshes lists: `controller.bumpRides()` (`lib/ui/device/device_page.dart:89`) → `ShellController.bumpRides()` (`lib/ui/shell/shell_controller.dart:164`).

**C. Uploads to the device (`mtp/import/`)**

- `lib/ui/ride/import_upload.dart` — task kind `'import_upload'` (`:23`).
  - `ImportUpload.push({context, localPath|bytes, required defaultName})` (`:56`): prompt for a name via `askName` (`:33-48`, uses `HelmPromptDialog.show`, `initial: stem(initial)`), then `_send` → `McuSync.pushImportFile` (`:106`) or `pushImportBytes` (`:98`).
  - `lib/ui/ride/mcu_sync.dart:143-174`: `pushImportBytes` writes `label = displayName?.trim()` into the GPX via `GpxUtil.setName(...)` (`:161-166`) and uploads as `mtp/import/<safeFileName>` (`:167-172`).

## 2. Where names come from today

**GPX parsing — `lib/ride/gpx_util.dart`**

```dart
18:  static final _nameRe = RegExp(
19:    r'<name>\s*([^<]+)\s*</name>',
20:    caseSensitive: false,
21:  );
...
94:  static GpxSummary parse(String xml) {
95:    var name = '';
96:    final m = _nameRe.firstMatch(xml);
97:    if (m != null) {
98:      name = m.group(1)!.trim();
99:    }
```

So: **the first `<name>` in document order wins** — it is not specifically `<trk><name>` and not specifically `<metadata><name>`. Whichever appears first (metadata normally precedes trk, but a leading `<wpt><name>` would also win) is used. There is no file-name-based naming from inside the parser; the file name is only the fallback in `RideRecord.title` (`ride_record_store.dart:46-53`).

`setName` (used by rename and by upload-to-device) **replaces every `<name>` in the document**:

```dart
659:  static String setName(String xml, String name) {
660:    final esc = _esc(name.trim());
661:    if (esc.isEmpty) return xml;
662:    if (_nameRe.hasMatch(xml)) {
663:      return xml.replaceAll(_nameRe, '<name>$esc</name>');
```

Confirmed by test `test/gpx_util_test.dart:148-157` (`<metadata><name>old</name></metadata><trk><name>old</name></trk>` → both become the new name). Consequence: route-point `<name>` labels (e.g. `<rtept><name>3</name></rtept>`) are also overwritten when renaming or uploading.

**Records pulled from the device**

Name comes from the GPX body, not the `mtp/record/<file>.gpx` path. `McuSync.pullRideRecords` passes only `fileName: e.name` (`mcu_sync.dart:105-109`); `RideRecordStore.putFile` sets `displayName` from `GpxUtil.parse(xml).name` (`ride_record_store.dart:223, 234-236`). ## 5. Coordinate conversion contract

`lib/map/osm_tiles.dart:11, 27-36`:

```dart
/// 展示前用 [toDisplay] 把 GPS/GPX 的 WGS-84 转过去。
  /// 底图是火星坐标。
  static const usesGcj02 = true;
  /// GPS / GPX → 地图显示。
  static LatLng toDisplay(LatLng wgs84) => usesGcj02 ? ChinaCoord.wgs84ToGcj02(wgs84) : wgs84;
  /// 地图点选 → GPS / 路网。
  static LatLng fromDisplay(LatLng map) => usesGcj02 ? ChinaCoord.gcj02ToWgs84(map) : map;
```

`lib/map/china_coord.dart:14-36`: `wgs84ToGcj02` adds the standard delta (Krasovsky 6378245.0, ee 0.00669342162296594323, `_transformLat/_transformLon`); `gcj02ToWgs84` is the 4-iteration inverse. Points outside China (`outOfChina` bbox, `:11-12`) are returned unchanged.

**Stored track coordinates are WGS-84**: GPX points come from device GNSS and are parsed raw (`gpx_util.dart:168-205`), routing uses OSRM/BRouter in raw WGS-84 (`road_router.dart:114-133`), map-picked points are converted back with `HelmOsmTiles.fromDisplay` before storage (`waypoint_editor_page.dart:474` uses `toDisplay` for camera; favorites use `fromDisplay`). Conversion only happens at display/tile boundaries (`ride_detail_page.dart:85` `_disp = HelmOsmTiles.toDisplayAll(sum.points)`).

**An AMap/高德 HTTP API (e.g. `restapi.amap.com/v3/geocode/regeo`) expects GCJ-02 input** (Amap docs: input/output are GCJ-02 "火星坐标"); so raw WGS-84 track points would need `ChinaCoord.wgs84ToGcj02(...)` first, and the returned POI/address coordinates are GCJ-02. The existing tile contract reinforces the same rule: `OsmCity.gcjSouthWest/gcjNorthEast` convert the WGS-84 catalog bbox before building tile URLs (`osm_city_catalog.dart:53-57`).


`fromJson` at `:73-87` reads the same keys (`displayName` `:83`, `userRenamed` `:85` with default `false`). `_flush()` rewrites the whole array (`:186-191`).

**`GpxLibraryStore`** — `documents/gpx_import/index.json` (`lib/ride/gpx_library_store.dart:23, 30`), a JSON array of the exact same `RideRecord` shape (shared class; `load` at `:32-49`, `_flush` at `:51-56`). Note `GpxLibraryStore` has **no** `setDisplayName`/`userRenamed` writer — only `putBytes` (`:58-82`, which recomputes `displayName` from the GPX `<name>` and always leaves `userRenamed` at its default `false`) and `remove` (`:84-95`).

**Renaming today** (`RideRecordStore.setDisplayName`, `:267-290`) does three things: rewrites the `<name>` inside the local `.gpx` via `GpxUtil.setName` (`:277-278`), updates the record with `displayName: trimmed, userRenamed: true` (`:281-285`), then `_flush()` (`:288`). Because renaming modifies the file on disk, the change also survives if a `putFile` re-sync happens only through the `keepName` branch (`:213-219`) — but `GpxLibraryStore.putBytes` has no such branch, so a re-import of the same file name overwrites the entry and resets `userRenamed` to false.

Other stores for reference: `documents/nav_routes.json` — keys `id`, `name`, `updatedMs`, `points[].{name,lat,lon}` (`lib/ride/nav_route_store.dart:15-19, 48-53`); `documents/favorites.json` — keys `id`, `name`, `lat`, `lon` (`lib/ride/favorite_store.dart:19-23`).
